result.reason: The redline appropriately and narrowly extends the licence to Client’s affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf, but it does not address the required duration and transfer protections: paid-up licences are not made perpetual and irrevocable, subscription licences remain terminable under Section 12 rather than only for uncured material breach, and the licence is not transferable to successors, including an M&A successor. It therefore reaches neither the preferred position nor the fallback position.
